title: BIGROCK Sohtea: The Chinese Aethos half a year later
notes: Exact-model independent long-term review says three Sohtea bikes were built, reports roughly 780 g for a regular XS frame and 680 g for a Team XS frame, and describes the platform as laterally stiff and responsive out of the saddle. These are qualitative ride observations, not an instrumented deflection test.
